name: How do I know if my existing gas line is safe for my water heater?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my existing gas line is safe for my water heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you suspect issues with your gas line, such as a sulfur or rotten egg smell (indicating a gas leak), visible corrosion on pipes, or a yellow or orange flame at your water heater's burner (should be blue), you should contact a professional immediately. Even without these obvious signs, an older gas line or one that hasn't been inspected in years might not meet current safety standards or could be undersized for a new appliance. A professional inspection can assess its condition and ensure it's safe.
acceptedAnswer.description: Check for gas smells, pipe corrosion, or an improper flame color. For older lines or new appliances, a professional inspection ensures safety.
